chapter_note: This short chapter is dominated by a systematic five-fold classification of Fire’s operations, expressed in an impersonal, enumerative teaching voice. The only clear later element is the dialogue/frame attribution at the start (“Once more he speaks”), which should be stripped; otherwise the content stays in descriptive ‘how it works’ mode without NT citation or institutional application.

paragraphs.core_text: This fire, which burns and is apparent today in the world, it does five works.
paragraphs.removed_material: Removed opening dialogue/frame attribution (“Once more he speaks:”), a later hagiographic/editorial container formula.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Mixed because it begins with a formulaic speaker-attribution typical of the compilation frame; the remainder introduces a structured five-work schema in an expository voice.

paragraphs.core_text: The first work that it does is this: It incinerates and burns wood, and everything that shall be placed upon it.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Core: numbered, impersonal, systematic description of Fire’s operation within an ordered schema (five works), without citation or ecclesial application.

paragraphs.core_text: The second: It separates four aspects of the wood, which are these: fire and light, ash and smoke.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Core: classificatory/analytical mode (enumerated ‘second’ + fourfold separation) characteristic of the older technical teaching register.

paragraphs.core_text: The third: It gives a taste and an {aroma} to whatever will be cooked on it. It also gives heat and cheer to whoever will be close to it.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Core: continues the fivefold sequence, describing sensory/affective effects as part of Fire’s defined functions (still descriptive, not exhortative).

paragraphs.core_text: The fourth work that [it] does: All craftsmen shall work the utensils that they will fabricate in it.
paragraphs.temporal_note: Core: maintains the impersonal list structure and functional definition of Fire; no institutional ‘pointing at’ beyond ordinary craft activity.

paragraphs.core_text: The fifth: It shall display light, and the people see by [it].
paragraphs.temporal_note: Core: completes the fivefold set with a final functional operation (illumination), closing the systematic sequence cleanly.
